scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d && docker compose exec db sh -c 'until pg_isready -U haitianhong; do sleep 0.2; done' && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.test-db:reset: docker compose rm -sfv db-test && docker volume rm -f liferpg_pgdata-test && docker compose up -d db-test && docker compose exec db-test sh -c 'until pg_isready -U haitianhong; do sleep 0.2; done' && pnpm test-db:migrate && pnpm test-db:seed
